SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-20: FHIRPath — §9 Environment Variables, §10 Types and Reflection, §11 Type Safety, §12 Formal Specifications. Test these items: Environment variable access (%context, %resource, etc.), Model information, SimpleTypeInfo, ClassInfo, ListTypeInfo, TupleTypeInfo, Type safety rules, Formal syntax (ANTLR), URI and media types. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath 2018Sep §6.3 (as operator) vs official R4 fixtures testFHIRPathAsFunction11/12
issues.evidence: status is string -> true but status.as(string) -> empty on both engines. Official R4 fixtures pin as/ofType as EXACT-match for primitives; fixtures outrank spec prose. Reconfirmed on uri-family members and unqualified type specifiers (131-case dual-path probe, 0 parity diffs).

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath grammar (2018Sep and N1): literal : '{' '}' — no tuple production
issues.evidence: {a: 1}, {a: 'x'}, {a: {b: 1}} all rejected as syntax errors identically on native and fallback. The official grammar has no non-empty literal/tuple production; launch-note supposition that tuple literals are in the grammar is incorrect.
issues.root_cause: Grammar conforms to official ANTLR spec

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §9 Environment Variables; FHIR spec fhirpath.html env-var additions (%terminologies)
issues.evidence: %terminologies and %environment undefined -> empty with consistent 'undefined environment variable' error classification on both engines; %ucum/%sct/%loinc predefined. FHIR-spec-added terminology-service endpoint is a host extension point; undefined behavior left open by base §9.
issues.root_cause: Host extension point; no terminology service configured
